statements.t: The decrease of $118 million is primarily a result of a smaller PRT market during 2026 and our pricing discipline related to expected returns on this business.
The decrease of $643 million is primarily a result of a smaller PRT market during 2026 and our pricing discipline related to expected returns on this business as noted above.

The decrease of $1.5 billion is primarily due to our strong pricing discipline related to expected returns which resulted in decreased sales activity in some of our fixed index and fixed rate retail annuity products as well as a decline in PRT sales, which were also impacted by a smaller PRT market in 2026.

Annuity sales declined year over year due to our strong pricing discipline related to expected returns which resulted in decreased sales in some of our fixed index annuity products along with PRT annuities, which were also impacted by a smaller PRT market during 2026.

The decrease of $112 million was primarily attributable to lower PRT sales in the quarter as compared to the prior year due to a smaller PRT market during 2026 and our pricing discipline related to expected return on this business.

Net premiums and other policy revenue of $914 million decreased by $606 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, compared to the same period in 2025 primarily due to lower PRT sales as compared to the prior year period due to a smaller PRT market during 2026 and our pricing discipline related to expected return on this business.
The timing and amount of any such transactions will be determined at our discretion.
